howto.what: Claude 会指导你如何集成和使用 Firebase In-App 消息：包括初始化、按事件触发或抑制消息、设置用户隐私同意、以及用设备 ID 测试消息。

say.text: 我想在用户付费后触发一条应用内消息。
say.note: Claude 会演示程序化触发事件。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through integrating and using Firebase In-App Messaging: initialization, triggering or suppressing messages by events, setting privacy opt-in, and testing with device IDs.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to set up or manage in-app messages, such as triggering by events, suppressing messages, configuring privacy consent, or testing on specific devices.

say_en.text: How do I set up Firebase In-App Messaging in a Flutter project?
say_en.note: Claude provides installation and initialization steps.

say_en.text: I want to trigger an in-app message after a user completes a purchase.
How can I test messages on a specific device?
